public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let remaining be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let ordered be []
  let mutable done_steps be Set of Text()

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable ready be []
    for each step in remaining
      let deps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
      let unmet be for each dep in deps where not done_steps.contains(dep) collect dep
      if unmet.is_empty() then
        set ready to ready.append(step)
      end
    end

    if ready.is_empty() then
      fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
    end

    set ready to ready.sorted()
    for each step in ready
      set ordered to ordered.append(step)
      set done_steps to done_steps.add(step)
      set remaining to remaining.without(step)
    end
  end

  return ordered
end

  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"]))
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let remaining be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let mutable ordered be []
  let mutable done be Set of Text()
  let mutable visiting be Set of Text()

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable progress be false

    for each step in remaining.sorted()
      if done.contains(step) then
        ignore remaining.without(step)
      otherwise
        let deps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
        let mutable missing be nothing
        for each dep in deps
          if not dependencies.contains_key(dep) then
            set missing to dep
            break
          end
        end
        if missing is not nothing then
          fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: missing)
        end

        let mutable ready be true
        for each dep in deps
          if not done.contains(dep) then
            set ready to false
            break
          end
        end

        if ready then
          set ordered to ordered.append(step)
          set done to done.add(step)
          set remaining to remaining.without(step)
          set progress to true
        end
      end
    end

    if not progress then
      fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining.sorted())
    end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let mutable remaining be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let mutable ordered be []
  let mutable done_steps be []

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable ready be []

    for each step in remaining
      let deps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
      let all_done be for each dep in deps all done_steps.contains(dep)
      if all_done then
        set ready to ready.append(step)
      end
    end

    if ready.is_empty() then
      let mutable remaining_deps be []
      for each step in remaining
        let deps be dependencies.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
        for each dep in deps
          if not done_steps.contains(dep) and not remaining.contains(dep) then
            set remaining_deps to remaining_deps.append(dep)
          end
        end
      end

      if remaining_deps.is_empty() then
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
      otherwise
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: remaining.first(), depends_on: remaining_deps.first())
      end
    end

    set ready to ready.sorted()
    for each step in ready
      set ordered to ordered.append(step)
      set done_steps to done_steps.append(step)
      set remaining to remaining.without(step)
    end
  end

  return ordered
end

public function order(dependencies: Map of Text to List of Text)
  returns List of Text
  or fails with OrderError
  purpose: A topological order of the steps; ties are broken alphabetically so the result is stable.
  tags: graph, topological-sort, build
  example: order({"test": ["build"], "build": ["fetch"], "fetch": []}) is ["fetch", "build", "test"]
  example: order({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}) fails with Cycle(remaining: ["a", "b"])
  example: order({"test": ["lint"]}) fails with UnknownDependency(step: "test", depends_on: "lint")

  let remaining be dependencies.keys().sorted()
  let ordered be []
  let mutable done_steps be Set of Text()
  let mutable pending be dependencies

  repeat until remaining.is_empty()
    let mutable progress be false

    for each step in remaining
      let deps be pending.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
      let unresolved be deps.where(depends_on in not done_steps.contains(depends_on)).sorted()
      if unresolved.is_empty() then
        set ordered to ordered.append(step)
        set done_steps to done_steps.add(step)
        set pending to pending.without(step)
        set progress to true
      end
    end

    if progress then
      set remaining to pending.keys().sorted()
    otherwise
      let mutable missing_step be ""
      let mutable missing_dep be ""
      for each step in remaining
        let deps be pending.get(step) otherwise fail with UnknownDependency(step: step, depends_on: step)
        for each depends_on in deps.sorted()
          if not dependencies.contains_key(depends_on) and not done_steps.contains(depends_on) then
            set missing_step to step
            set missing_dep to depends_on
            break
          end
        end
        if missing_step is not "" then
          break
        end
      end

      if missing_step is not "" then
        fail with UnknownDependency(step: missing_step, depends_on: missing_dep)
      otherwise
        fail with Cycle(remaining: remaining)
      end
    end
  end

  return ordered
end
